subject: Handoff decision: typing-pause trigger for v1, distillation in Q3
body:
Team,

Handoff decision, made with the editor team yesterday:

1. V1 ships with the typing-pause trigger and server-side batching - 380ms is invisible behind a natural pause, and the 68% vs 17% preference number is too good to sit on for a quarter.
2. Decoder distillation is the headline Q3 item, funded from the B-24 earmark. Idris, looping you in so the writeup lands in your Q3 cycle - Deshawn will send the breakdown (roughly $70k fine-tuning runs, $30k human evals, $20k distillation compute).
3. Quentin runs a second eval round post-integration so we have fresh numbers for the editor team's own launch review.

Gustavo - the rewrite-pair data doc goes to the editor team with the handoff, incl. the known coverage gaps.

Great sprint, everyone.

Priya
